claims: American Horror Story Season 13 is officially in production for a Halloween 2026 release.
Jessica Lange is returning to American Horror Story after eight years.
Filming for American Horror Story Season 13 began in New York City in April 2026.

Confirmed cast members of American Horror Story Season 13 include Jessica Lange, Sarah Paulson, Evan Peters, Angela Bassett, Kathy Bates, Emma Roberts, Billie Lourd, Gabourey Sidibe, Leslie Grossman, and Ariana Grande.
Jessica Lange previously stated she would never return to American Horror Story.
Jessica Lange was spotted on set for American Horror Story Season 13 in photos shared by Ryan Murphy.
Jessica Lange was wearing a blue dress and heels in photos shared by Ryan Murphy.
An official title for American Horror Story Season 13 has not been finalized.
Ryan Murphy hinted at a "Coven" connection for American Horror Story Season 13.
Ryan Murphy told a fan "Done" when asked for a Coven continuation.
Filming for American Horror Story Season 13 runs in New York City from April 6 to July 22, 2026.
The premiere of American Horror Story Season 13 is expected around Halloween 2026.
American Horror Story Season 13 is expected to consist of 13 episodes.
